title: Symlink resolution for osf check and scan
summary: Adds a shared `symlink` module that decides what a symlink means to the scanner: a link whose real target lives inside the repository is followed to the real files behind it, while a link pointing outside the repository, into `.git`, at nothing, or in a loop is refused with a `symlink refused:` error. `check scan`, `check lint-writing` and `check lint-skill` now expand their named paths through this module before existence checks, and the directory walker in `scan` follows in-repo links instead of counting them as skipped. The net effect is that the `.claude/skills -> ../.agents/skills` layout is scanned rather than reported missing, and a scan of nothing but symlinks is no longer silently clean.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: check <name> [paths...]
nodes.summary: Parses the check subcommand and the explicit paths, then hands them to the check dispatcher.

nodes.label: run_check
nodes.subtitle: fn run_check(name, opts, files, gate)
nodes.summary: Dispatches on CheckName. The Scan, LintWriting and LintSkill arms now expand symlinks before the existence check, so a linked path is validated against its real targets rather than the link itself.

nodes.label: ensure_files_exist
nodes.subtitle: not-found pre-flight
nodes.summary: Still the caller's own not-found error: expand_links passes a missing path through unchanged precisely so this check keeps firing for it.

nodes.label: symlink module
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/symlink.rs
nodes.summary: New module registered in lib.rs. Owns the policy for what a link means: follow inside the repository, refuse outside, dangling, .git or looping.

nodes.label: expand_links
nodes.subtitle: fn expand_links(root, files) -> Vec<String>
nodes.summary: Entry point used by the check arms. Canonicalizes the root once, passes plain and missing paths through, replaces each link with the repository-relative paths of the real files behind it, and dedupes first-seen.

nodes.label: resolve_link
nodes.subtitle: fn resolve_link(root, link)
nodes.summary: Entry point used by the scan walker. Returns one (label, real) pair per file behind a link, where label is the path as walked through the link.

nodes.label: follow
nodes.subtitle: fn follow(link, label)
nodes.summary: Walks a link's own chain to its real target, tracking seen link identities so two links pointing at each other are caught as a loop rather than spun on.

nodes.label: inside_repository
nodes.subtitle: root prefix, minus .git
nodes.summary: The boundary test: a real target must start with the canonical root and must not start with root/.git. This is what turns an outside or .git link into a refusal.

nodes.label: walk_dir
nodes.subtitle: recursive, sorted, skips .git
nodes.summary: Walks the real directory behind a link, resolving nested links by the same rules and refusing a directory that cycles back on an ancestor.

nodes.label: collect_files
nodes.subtitle: fn collect_files(root, path, out)
nodes.summary: The scan walker. Previously counted a symlink into `skipped`; now calls resolve_link and pushes the real files behind it, labelled by the path walked through the link.

nodes.label: resolve_scan_targets
nodes.subtitle: fn resolve_scan_targets(dir, paths)
nodes.summary: Builds the (label, real) target list. The skipped counter is gone from the explicit-path branch; git-tracked mode still reports tracked symlinks as excluded.

nodes.label: scan_files
nodes.subtitle: reads targets, emits findings
nodes.summary: Reads each target, skips binaries and excluded paths, and reports findings. Unchanged, but now receives real files that were previously never read.

nodes.label: lint_writing_files
nodes.subtitle: writing lint
nodes.summary: Unchanged implementation; its input list now arrives already expanded by expand_links.

nodes.label: lint_skill_files
nodes.subtitle: skill lint
nodes.summary: Unchanged implementation; the linked `.claude/skills` directory now resolves to real SKILL.md files instead of a file-not-found.

nodes.label: Repository working tree
nodes.subtitle: real files, links, .git
nodes.summary: The files and symlinks on disk. Links inside the tree are now traversed; links out of it are never read.

nodes.label: symlink unit tests
nodes.subtitle: inside, outside, loop, dangling, .git, dedup
nodes.summary: Nine unit tests pin the policy: inside directory and file expand, outside and .git are refused, parent and mutual links loop, dangling points at nothing, plain and missing paths pass through, duplicates keep first-seen order.

nodes.label: check integration tests
nodes.subtitle: follow, refuse, loop, linked skills
nodes.summary: End-to-end coverage through the CLI: a linked directory's leak is reported, an outside link and a loop exit 2 with `symlink refused`, and the linked skills directory lints clean.

nodes.label: scan integration tests
nodes.subtitle: explicit link now followed
nodes.summary: The old assertions that an explicit symlinked directory is skipped and counted excluded are inverted: it is now followed and its finding reported.

edges.label: expand before existence check
edges.summary: The change's centre of gravity: every named path is expanded through the new module before anything else looks at it.

edges.label: boundary test
edges.summary: The single predicate that separates a followed link from a refused one.

edges.label: nested link
edges.summary: A link found inside a linked directory is resolved by the same rules, so the policy is uniform at every depth.

edges.label: expanded path list
edges.summary: Missing paths pass through unchanged, so the not-found error still fires for them.

edges.label: link found while walking
edges.summary: Replaces the old `skipped += 1`: a link met during a walk is now resolved rather than counted.

edges.label: reads real files
edges.summary: Only real paths inside the repository are ever read; outside, .git, dangling and looping links are refused before any read.
